title: User guide 2: From content to approval
bullets: Import and check it, fix errors
subtitle: User guide 2: From content to approval
narration: Welcome to user guide two. This guide shows how to get the lesson content, import and check it, fix any errors, and send it through review to approval.

subtitle: Open a language, click Show ChatGPT prompt
narration: Open the lesson, then click one language version, for example English. Step one is getting the content. Click Show ChatGPT prompt.

subtitle: Copy the prompt into ChatGPT yourself
narration: The app has prepared a prompt from your lesson, with the class, subject, topic, language and length. Click Copy prompt, paste it into ChatGPT yourself, and save the two files it returns: lesson dot C S V and lesson plan dot J S O N. The app never talks to ChatGPT.

subtitle: Errors are listed. Nothing is imported.
narration: Step two is importing. If a file has problems, the app lists them in plain words and imports nothing. Here two required columns are missing. Fix the file and try again.

subtitle: Choose files, Check only, then Import
narration: Choose a ZIP, or the C S V together with the lesson plan. Click Check only to test the files without saving. When they pass, click Import.

subtitle: Looks good: slides and estimated minutes
narration: When the check passes, the app shows the number of slides and the estimated narration time. If this differs a lot from your target, you will see a note.

subtitle: Step 3: review every slide
narration: After importing, step three is reviewing the content. Check the learning objectives, then read the narration, subtitle and visual instruction of every slide.

subtitle: Click Send for review
narration: When the content is ready, click Send for review. The status changes to in review.

subtitle: Reviewer: Approve or Request changes
narration: The reviewer reads the content and decides. Add a note, then click Approve. To ask for corrections, click Request changes, and a note is required. Rejecting also needs a note.

subtitle: Status: approved
narration: The version is now approved. Only approved versions can be sent to video production. If you import new content later, the approval is cancelled and a new review is needed.

subtitle: History shows who decided what, and when
narration: The history at the bottom records every step, with the note and the time.

title: Remember
bullets: Every language version is reviewed separately
Only approved content goes to video production
subtitle: Next: generate the video
narration: Remember, use Check only before importing, review each language separately, and only approved content goes to video production. Next, the guide for generating the video.
